text: Older rebased evidence patchsets may contain no runtime hunks beyond a version bump; when merge-plan classifies queuebash.sh as manual review, inspect the diff before applying so an older patch does not downgrade a newer merger base. Tags: bob15 merge-plan evidence-only version-guard.

For queue dev merge-plan, pass the patchset zip path to --patchset. Passing an already-unzipped patch directory triggers IsADirectoryError in queue-dev-merge-plan.py and is not the supported command shape. Tags: bob15 merge-plan zip-path.

If queue dev ai through the sourced queue dispatcher is slow in sandbox, direct bin/queue-dev-ai with QUEUEBASH_SCRIPT_PATH and QUEUEBASH_DEV_SCRATCHPAD set still records package-local sessions and lessons without touching runtime semantics. Tags: bob15 queue-dev-ai dogfood sandbox.
